question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

I feel I am ______ raw for this new position.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3;**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"too"** means to a higher degree than is desirable, permissible, or possible; excessively. (बहुत अधिक)

 
 
• **Example: **She was** too **tired to continue the hike.
 
 
 
• **"Raw"** refers to something in its natural state, not yet processed or refined. (कच्चा)
 
 
• **Example: **The** raw **data needs to be processed before we can analyze it.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Most** (सबसे अधिक): Greatest in amount, extent, or degree.

 
 
• **Example:** She is the most talented singer in the group.
 
 
 
• **Two** (दो): The number after one and before three.
 
 
• **Example: **They have two children.
 
 
 
• **To** (को): Expressing motion in the direction of a particular location.
 
 
• **Example:** I am going to the market.
